args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy was rolled out to all production regions. I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Health checks should recover; error rates were around 18% on v2.3.1. A SEV2 ticket is opened to track investigation into the root cause of v2.3.1's failure.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Verified the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks, with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent production release that was healthy, and rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all regions. The rollback completed successfully and is verified.
3. **Opened incident**: Filed a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of v2.3.1's failure (and a fix or re-deploy) will still need investigation by the on-call team.
